messages:
zara: FYI — AcmeCorp reported failed webhooks to our hosted endpoint. They see `TLS handshake failed` and say their outbound firewall only allows 3 IPs. Need a quick mitigation.
erin: Thanks, forwarding ticket link pls. Which region is the customer in? We can try a temporary NAT reservation.
zara: Ticket #12345. Region: eu-west1. Their allowlist: 35.200.12.3, 35.200.12.4, 35.200.12.5. Our request logs show egress from 34.120.18.45 then 34.120.18.46 during retries — so they dropped the second connection.
mian: Classic ephemeral NAT mismatch. Short options: (a) ask customer to allow hostname / SNI instead of IPs, (b) route traffic through customer's outbound proxy (we support CONNECT), or (c) provide dedicated static egress IP(s) for them (reserved NAT) — long term product/paid. For immediate relief we can temporarily allocate a static IP from eu-west1.
kevin: If they won't change firewall, easiest remedial step is 'give them one IP to add'. Ops: can we carve out a /32 from the eu-west1 NAT pool for a few days? Also we should update the external docs with an example proxy snippet.
erin: I'll allocate a temp IP if pool has capacity. mian — can you confirm available IPs and create an internal allocation task? Also note for the customer: we expose original client info via X-Forwarded-For, not a custom X-Redwood header.
mian: I have 2 free ephemeral IPs in the eu-west1 pool right now. Creating task INF-2091 to reserve one for acme temporarily. For the proxy option, we support `CONNECT` with basic auth. Example client curl I usually send: ```curl --proxy http://user:pass@proxy.acme.local:8080 -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hooks -d '{}'```
infra-bot: Automated: created allocation task INF-2091 (owner: @mian). ETA ~45m.
zara: Great — I'll reply to the customer with two choices: 1) add the temp IP(s) (we'll provide IP and TTL), or 2) configure their proxy to CONNECT to our endpoint (we provided snippet). Also propose long-term option: dedicated egress pool for customers on contract. :thumbsup:
kevin: Agreed — filing a product feature request to expose a managed "egress-hostname" / paid static-IP offering (PRD-452).
erin: Action items: erin -> allocate temp NAT IPs in INF-2091, mian -> confirm IP + update egress docs with example proxy and SNI guidance, zara -> update customer with options, kevin -> file product request PRD-452. Will update thread when IP is assigned.
